plugin.name: Sniper Elite Fusion Fix
ResX.description: Width of the screen in pixels. 0 uses the desktop resolution.
ResY.description: Height of the screen in pixels. 0 uses the desktop resolution.
FOVFactor.description: Multiplies the gameplay field of view. 1.0 keeps the original framing; larger values widen the view, up to 150 degrees across. Cinematics and the scope keep their framing. Applies immediately.
ConfineCursor.description: Keep the cursor inside the game window while the game is active. It is released when the game loses the focus, while the window is moved and at once when this is turned off.
FMVWidescreenMode.description: Original aspect shows the movies as the game does, whole inside its centred 4:3 frame with black bars around them. Fill fits the whole movie to the screen, without cutting anything off or stretching it.
WindowMode.description: Fullscreen, a window at the chosen resolution, or borderless: a window covering the whole monitor at its resolution. Restart required.
PauseOnFocusLoss.description: In a window mode, the game pauses and goes silent while another window is active. Off keeps it running. Applies immediately.
CheckForUpdates.description: Once per start, asks fusionfix.io whether a newer version of the fix is out and tells you in the game. Off makes no network request.
HudAspectRatioConstraint.description: Auto spreads the HUD across the whole screen, at its sides. A ratio keeps it in a centred box of that shape. Menus keep their 4:3 layout. Applies immediately.
update.availablehub: {name} {version} is available. FusionFixHub opens when you close the game.
update.title: Update available
CutsceneBorders.description: Cutscene black bars keep their original wide frame at any screen aspect ratio. On: the original cutscenes with black bars. Off: cutscenes without black bars. Applies immediately.
SkipIntro.description: Skips the legal screen and the Rebellion logo movie at startup; the intro movie still plays and can be skipped with the game's own button. Restart required.
FPSLimit.description: Limits the frame rate. Applies immediately.
